 "rationale": "Budget: 39uW/1.8V = 21.7uA. Assuming IREF=10uA, tail=4uA and stage2=5uA gives 19uA (34uW). The input pair is in weak inversion, so gm is high. The load uses short L, keeping the preamp gain near 10. This bounds the preamp time constant, so the 10mV step crosses in about 1ns. Stage 2 is current-starved and slews about 1V/ns. The inverter drives 50fF rail-to-rail in about 0.3ns. M5 is a scaled replica of the load, which removes systematic offset."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_ld": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "L_cs":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 6e-6),
    "I2":      (5e-6, 2.5e-6, 7e-6),
    "Wn_inv":  (0.6, 0.42, 1.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]
    gmid_cs = 10.0

    # bias diode and mirrors (same L, same gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], It, vds=0.4)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmid_cs, p["L_cs"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode M3, M4) and the replica CS device M5
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], It / 2, vds=0.85)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # preamp: vinp up -> o1 up
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # gain stage: o1 up -> o2 down
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # output inverter: o2 down -> vout up
    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]
    Wp = 2.5 * Wn
    n.M("MIN", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIP", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # ---- predictions ----
    go1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / go1
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / go1
    t1 = math.log(2) * tau1                      # single-pole crossing from -A1*vod to +A1*vod
    Cinv = (Wn + Wp) * 0.15 * 1e-14 + (Wn + Wp) * 0.6e-15
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + Cinv + 0.5e-15
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / I2                     # stage-2 slew-limited (falling edge is the worst case)
    Ion = 250e-6 * Wn                            # approximate inverter drive current
    t3 = cl * (vdd / 2) / Ion
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)
    offset = 0.0                                 # M5 is a replica of M4, so there is no systematic offset
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "A1": A1, "tau1": tau1}
